history.summary: A 28-year-old 99-year leasehold 4BR in Geylang/Paya Lebar (D14), 330m from CC9/EW8 Paya Lebar MRT interchange, listed at $1,570 psf — ~7% above the $1,469 URA median. Excellent interchange location and the Paya Lebar Central catalyst, but a leasehold from 1998 (~71 years left) plus an above-median 4BR price drag it down.
history.rating_rationale: Location is genuinely strong: 330m to the Paya Lebar CC9/EW8 interchange (dual-line), inside the Paya Lebar Central commercial transformation zone (airbase relocation creating new land) — a real future catalyst. The 5.6%/yr URA rate on 49 txns is reliable. But several negatives explain the very low 361 score and cap this to Neutral: (1) it is a 1998 99-year leasehold, ~71 years remaining, so lease decay is a material forward drag and CPF/financing limits loom; (2) the 4BR is listed ~7% ABOVE the $1,469 median — paying up, not a discount; (3) $2.4M for an aging leasehold 4BR is a narrower exit than the 2-3BR market. The interchange + Paya Lebar Central upside is real but partly offset by lease decay over a 5-7yr hold. Balanced Neutral — location saves it from Avoid, lease/price prevent a Buy.
